sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last ten matches and a positive goal difference of +12. They face a struggling Alsager side sitting bottom of the division with just four points from ten games.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive, with second-placed Stafford Town hosting Dawley Town on Saturday and looking to bounce back from their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, will bid to extend their recent winning form at home against Eccleshall, who sit fifth but have won their last match. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) travel to face Wednesfield Community before a midweek clash at Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town, in sixth place, host Foley Meir in what should be a competitive encounter given Bilston's strong recent form. Mid-table battles include Barnton's home fixture against Shawbury United—notably Shawbury are winless in their last six outings—and New Mills away at Market Drayton Town. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; all three fixtures involve teams fighting to climb away from the lower reaches of the division. Widnes remain in deep trouble at the bottom with just two points from seven games.
